essence: Two raised-thumb fists constitute the Trailokyamohinī mudrā.
This gesture is declared the Kāmamudrā and is pleasing to all gods.
This gesture is declared the Liṅgamudrā and brings about Śiva's presence.
Placing the pair of thumb tips together forms the Yonimudrā.
Spreading the fingers forms the gesture proclaimed as Triśula.
